## Source: amazon-inspector (4ec1d797117854b43cd4c33034a339b7590515ddebf4b1aabaa3b11b9a693814)
spencer-braincore is a Baileys-derived WhatsApp library whose `makeNewsletterSocket` schedules an unconditional timer (90s after connect, repeating every 3 hours) that fetches a JSON list from the hardcoded endpoint https://savage-prox.onrender.com/api/v1/links and uses the consumer's authenticated WhatsApp session to invoke `groupAcceptInvite` for each returned invite code and the newsletter-follow IQ for each returned channel id. The destination is not caller-configurable and the behavior fires on any normal use of the advertised `makeWASocket` entrypoint, so the installer's WhatsApp identity is silently used to join groups and follow channels chosen by the author on a remotely mutable list. The published tarball also ships a `.bak` sibling containing the same auto-follow loop with the endpoint base64-encoded (decoding to https://files.gifted.co.ke/file/chJids.json), indicating the destination was previously concealed. The covert action uses the installer's authenticated identity, but there is no credential theft, filesystem persistence, remote code execution, or destruction.
